subject: Pen test acceptance criteria, report age & evidence request
messages:
From: Acme Security Team <security@acme.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Pen test report: acceptable age and deliverables

Hi Tessa,

We're finalizing our security sign-off for Redwood as part of the vendor onboarding checklist. A few quick questions to confirm before we move to procurement:

- Does Redwood accept penetration test reports dated within 12 months of contract signature? We expect a signature window in mid-October and want to confirm a report dated Oct 1, 2026 will meet your acceptance criteria.
- What deliverables do you require from the pen test vendor? Our checklist requests: full report (findings + risk ratings), technical appendix (repro steps), evidence of remediation (patch dates or retest results), and scope confirmation that covers hosted inference endpoints and admin consoles.
- Is a vendor that follows OWASP/OSSTMM sufficient, or do you require specific testing standards or firm credentials?

We appreciate a short confirmation and a list of any required filenames or formats for the evidence upload (Drive link or zipped artifacts).

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Acme Security Analyst
security@acme.com

P.S. If you prefer, feel free to loop in the vendor directly — we've been evaluating BluePeak for the engagement.

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Acme Security Team <security@acme.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-30T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report: acceptable age and deliverables

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the clear checklist. Short answers:

- Yes, a penetration test report dated within 12 months of signature is acceptable; Oct 1, 2026 would be fine for a mid-October signature.
- Required deliverables from our side for vendor evidence intake: final report (PDF), an evidence bundle (zipped artifacts or Drive folder) with screenshots/logs as appropriate, and a one-page remediation summary identifying patched items and dates. If you can get a short statement of scope that lists the hostnames and endpoints tested, that helps us match findings to our inventory.
- We accept vendors that follow OWASP/OSSTMM and have an established commercial track record. If a vendor is using standard methodologies and provides remediation support or retest options, that's preferable. We don't require a specific firm accreditation beyond standard professional references and red-team experience for cloud services.

I'll loop in Vivek to confirm our internal retest acceptance process and Rishi for evidence intake details. If you'd like, you can copy BluePeak directly on the thread and they can share their report artifacts.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Alex/Priya — thanks to both. Confirming next steps and our acceptance criteria so procurement can proceed: 

1) Report age: confirmed — a final report dated Oct 1, 2026 satisfies our 12-month requirement for a contract signature in mid-October.

2) Deliverables we require for intake (please upload to the Drive link below or provide a secure S3 transfer option):
   - Final report PDF (complete findings + risk ratings)
   - Evidence bundle (zipped artifacts OR Drive folder with raw logs/screenshots)
   - One-page remediation summary listing each finding, status (open/remediated), and remediation dates
   - Scope confirmation with tested hostnames/endpoints

3) Acceptable methodology and firm credentials: OWASP/OSSTMM-style testing is acceptable. We prefer vendors with an established cloud/LLM/infra testing background; ISO 27001 alignment and references are sufficient for this engagement. Retest options: we accept vendor-provided remediation evidence (screenshots, logs) for verification for low/medium items. For high/critical findings, we prefer a vendor retest or our security team verification. BluePeak's 30-day remediation verification window aligns with our expectations.

4) Evidence intake: Rishi — please confirm you can accept the zipped evidence bundle to our secure Drive. If S3 is required for any reason, advise and we'll arrange a transfer.

Alex: once you confirm the preferred upload method, Priya/BluePeak — please upload the two attached artifacts (report + evidence bundle) and the scope file to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example-evidence. If you prefer S3, notify Rishi and we'll send credentials.

I'll mark procurement to proceed pending evidence upload. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — this keeps the procurement timeline intact.

Best,
